causal_baseline.method: Copy the unchanged baseline committed dist bundle and the current causal boundary fixture into a private isolated directory, then execute the sixteen selected tests. Same late-completion fixtures used by the patched tests; no product timeout or authorization threshold relaxed.

actual_browser.recovery_witness: On each transport, the fixture withholds an already received real authorized Conversation snapshot at the application Promise boundary. The local incoming wait is aborted and closed while the same physical epoch remains connected. The original read is released; a fresh reader performs a second actual authorized snapshot request before yielding the same scoped pending invitation. No automatic accept/reject or mutation replay. This is a local scheduling/cancellation boundary, not a physical network stall.
actual_browser.cancellation_witness: A separate original invitation is cancelled before the recipient reader yields it. The bounded reader produces no stale invitation and the physical connection stays usable. Two such workflows pass. Current signed component cases additionally force cancellation while a snapshot is pending and compare exact original source/wire correlation.
actual_browser.regressions: The same current fixture retains Session reject/accept, additive Screen/data policy, opposite Screen decoding and causal gate/recovery checks, leave/reinvite/reaccept, original media/control/Session observation without custody, and current revoked authority refusal. There are 61 distinct original communication mutations, four transport credentials/keys, two Devices and four explicitly verified Endpoints.

implementation: Inbox keys include Conversation, Session, original server source and recipient. Fresh wire IDs with the same exact canonical payload deduplicate; a changed payload within retained history is a protocol failure. Capture isolates payload and excludes arbitrary envelope extensions.

Queue limit is 64 sources and 1 MiB canonical payload; overflow reports resync-required and retires the physical. Consumed/cancelled source history has a 256-source/1 MiB canonical-payload horizon. Queued entries remain pinned if history evicts their map entry. Each source retains four recent wire IDs; no indefinite exactly-once guarantee.

A source-correlated cancellation must match Conversation, Session and original source and must not add Connection/revision assertions. Unknown replies do not affect another source. Signed actor metadata is shape-validated; current server authorization can attribute cancellation to a different manager. Removal during a pending read prevents stale snapshot delivery.

Local reader timeout/abort/close peeks rather than consumes. One client-owned snapshot read has an independent fixed two-second deadline; later local waits drain earlier work and read current authorization afresh. They never release an abandoned cached snapshot or reset the old physical request budget. A permanent physical stall still retires at that owned deadline.

Current recipient identity, active membership epoch and invited appearance are checked before yielding. On retirement/reconnect, old queue/history and retained read references clear; late old-physical work cannot populate the replacement. No server/service/upstream policy implementation changed.
